title: Story library: one short story per investigation (docs/STORY-LIBRARY.md)
description: data/build/library.json, built by the pipeline. Text fields hook, reveal and bridge are AI-drafted (Meta Muse Spark) from data/build/psi-text.json only and carry the ai tag; the UI labels them 'AI summary'. They hold NO digits: every number on a library page comes from a moment (data/build/moments.json) or from experiments.json. core.quote is a verbatim substring (whitespace-normalised) of the investigation's PSI text.

title.description: the story title from the table in docs/STORY-LIBRARY.md

voice.description: the voice from the same table, e.g. 'the firefighter'

signature.description: the view the data can actually support: condition-map needs rows with oxygen and pressure; sample-wall lists the rows as cards; outcome-strip is one mark per row along the one recorded variable; paper-trail lists publications when there are no rows

hook.description: one or two plain sentences, no digits

reveal.description: what the tests did, in plain words, no digits

bridge.description: one line linking to the Moon-air question, or saying this one is about something else, no digits

moments.description: moment ids to show, the first is the story's climax; empty when the investigation has no rows
